title: Choose Dolphin’s Course Library composition
question: Which version feels like the polished minimalist software product Dolphin should become?

options.label: A — Focus first
options.thesis: The next Lesson leads; the rest of the Course Library stays quiet.
options.viewport: One focused continuation region followed by a compact Course list.
options.risk: The safest composition and the closest to a conventional product home.

options.label: B — Course index
options.thesis: Courses read as a disciplined index, with the current Course expanding in place.
options.viewport: A single typographic list with one expanded Course and no persistent sidebar.
options.risk: The strongest identity, but it relies on precise responsive typography.

options.label: C — Split view
options.thesis: The Course Library becomes a stable browser with the selected Course always in context.
options.viewport: A compact Course pane and a detailed Syllabus pane share one continuous frame.
options.risk: The most useful desktop composition, but it commits Dolphin to a stronger app shell.
